The sloth principle

Do the thinking once. Never repeat the boring part.

Designed for people with better things to do

The least ambitious workflow

Three small
moves.

01 / WATCH

Drop the clutter

Point SlothSort at a folder or add a handful of files. It starts with names and metadata, not uploads.

02 / NAP

Let a local model think

Use an Ollama-compatible open model when available. The built-in fallback still sorts common files offline.

03 / WAKE

Approve the calm

Review a transparent plan before anything moves. No surprise deletes, no mysterious cloud archive.

THE SLOW VERSION

Admin can be
less urgent.

SlothSort is a local-first file tidier for the folders you keep postponing. It proposes names and destinations, shows you the plan, and waits for one approval before moving anything.

No file contents leave your device in fallback mode. Try “Tidy all” to see the demo plan.
